_meta.description: Cached sample analysis output. Generated from sample_reviews.json using the full pipeline (Qwen3-8B + BGE-M3 + ChromaDB).

topics.name: Subscription & Billing Issues
topics.description: Complaints about unexpected charges, hidden fees, and difficulty canceling subscriptions.

topics.name: App Stability & Crashes
topics.description: Reports of crashes on launch, during workouts, and after updates on iOS 17.

topics.name: Workout Content Quality
topics.description: Positive feedback on workout variety, trainer quality, and results.

topics.name: Feature Requests
topics.description: Requests for postpartum workouts, Apple Watch heart rate tracking, and clearer content categorization.

findings.finding_text: Users report being charged immediately upon signing up for the free trial without clear disclosure of auto-conversion to a paid subscription.
The subscription cancellation flow is broken - the cancel button redirects to a non-functional page, forcing users to contact Apple Support.
Additional workout packs are sold as in-app purchases without clear indication of which content is included in the base subscription, leading to perceived hidden fees.
App crashes consistently on iOS 17.2, particularly when starting a workout after the countdown timer, affecting iPhone 14 users.
Users praise the variety and quality of workout routines, with reports of measurable results within 4-6 weeks.
Users request postpartum-specific workouts and Apple Watch heart rate integration.

requirements.requirement_text: Display explicit consent dialog before any subscription charge, clearly disclosing auto-conversion terms.
requirements.description: Add a pre-purchase consent dialog that shows the subscription price, billing cycle, and auto-renewal terms before the user confirms. The dialog must be acknowledged (not just dismissed) before Apple's In-App Purchase flow is triggered.
requirements.user_value: Eliminates surprise charges and builds trust.

requirements.requirement_text: Fix iOS 17.2 crash that occurs when starting a workout after the countdown timer.
requirements.description: Investigate and fix the crash triggered after the workout countdown timer on iOS 17.2 (iPhone 14). Likely related to AVPlayer or SceneDelegate lifecycle changes in iOS 17.
requirements.user_value: Allows paid users to actually use the app.
requirements.business_value: Prevents subscription cancellations due to unusable app.

requirements.requirement_text: Repair the in-app subscription cancellation flow so users can cancel without contacting Apple Support.
requirements.description: The cancel button currently redirects to a broken page. Fix the redirect to point to Apple's manage-subscription URL or implement an in-app cancellation flow.
requirements.user_value: Allows users to cancel subscriptions easily.
requirements.business_value: Compliance with App Store Review Guideline 3.1.2.

requirements.requirement_text: Add clear badges distinguishing included vs. premium (in-app purchase) workout packs.
requirements.description: Display a 'Premium' or 'Included' badge on each workout pack so users know what they get with their subscription vs. what requires additional purchase.

requirements.requirement_text: Add postpartum-specific workout category and Apple Watch heart rate integration.
requirements.description: Curate a postpartum workout category with low-impact, recovery-focused routines. Integrate HealthKit to display heart rate during workouts on Apple Watch.
requirements.business_value: Expands addressable market and increases retention.

versions.description: Critical fixes for billing and crashes - 3 requirements
UX improvements for content transparency - 1 requirement
New features for underserved segments - 1 requirement

test_cases.case_title: Verify explicit consent dialog appears before subscription purchase
test_cases.case_description: Ensure a consent dialog displaying price, billing cycle, and auto-renewal terms is shown before triggering the Apple In-App Purchase flow.
test_steps: Launch the app with a fresh install
Navigate to the subscription purchase screen
Tap 'Start Free Trial'
Verify the consent dialog appears with price, billing cycle, and auto-renewal terms
Verify the purchase flow does not proceed until the user explicitly taps 'Agree & Continue'
test_cases.expected_result: The consent dialog appears, displays all required disclosure information, and blocks the purchase flow until explicitly acknowledged.

test_cases.case_title: Verify no charge occurs during free trial without explicit consent
test_cases.case_description: Confirm the user is not charged until the trial ends and only if they have explicitly consented.
test_steps: Sign up for the free trial
Decline the consent dialog
Verify the purchase flow is aborted
Check that no charge appears in the sandbox account
test_cases.expected_result: No charge occurs if the user declines the consent dialog.

test_cases.case_title: Verify no crash on iOS 17.2 when starting a workout
test_cases.case_description: Ensure the app does not crash when the user starts a workout after the countdown timer on iOS 17.2.
test_steps: Install the app on iPhone 14 running iOS 17.2
Launch the app and sign in with a subscribed account
Select any workout from the library
Tap 'Start Workout'
Wait for the countdown timer to complete
Verify the workout video plays without crashing
test_cases.expected_result: The workout video plays successfully after the countdown timer without any crash.

test_cases.case_title: Verify subscription cancellation button redirects to Apple's manage-subscription page
test_cases.case_description: Ensure the cancel subscription button redirects the user to a working Apple manage-subscription URL.
test_steps: Sign in with a subscribed account
Navigate to Settings > Subscription
Tap 'Cancel Subscription'
Verify the user is redirected to Apple's manage-subscription page (itms-apps://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions)
Verify the page loads successfully
test_cases.expected_result: The user is successfully redirected to Apple's manage-subscription page and can cancel the subscription.

test_cases.case_title: Verify 'Included' and 'Premium' badges display correctly on workout packs
test_cases.case_description: Ensure workout packs that are part of the base subscription show an 'Included' badge, and packs requiring an additional purchase show a 'Premium' badge.
test_steps: Sign in with a subscribed account
Browse the workout library
Verify each workout pack displays either an 'Included' or 'Premium' badge
Tap a 'Premium' pack and verify it prompts for an additional purchase
Tap an 'Included' pack and verify it starts immediately
test_cases.expected_result: All workout packs display the correct badge and behave consistently with their badge.

test_cases.case_title: Verify postpartum workout category appears and contains curated content
test_cases.case_description: Ensure a postpartum-specific workout category exists and contains low-impact recovery routines.
test_steps: Sign in with a subscribed account
Navigate to the workout categories
Verify a 'Postpartum' category exists
Tap the category and verify it contains at least 5 curated workouts
Open a workout and verify it is low-impact and recovery-focused
test_cases.expected_result: Postpartum category exists with at least 5 low-impact recovery workouts.
